messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — noticed a path where the Console temporarily grants editor when a KMS key rotation fails in staging. Repro steps below.
Tom Reynolds: details?
Maya Patel: Steps: create project -> invite user as viewer -> rotate KMS key via UI. After rotation, some viewer users show editor in the UI and we emit role_assign events.
Jin Park: screenshot or logs? :eyes:
Maya Patel: pasted logs: ```
INFO 2026-03-15T14:02:03Z audit: {"event":"role_assign","user":"alice@example.com","assigned_role":"editor","source":"console-ui","reason":"kms-rotation-success"}
WARN 2026-03-15T14:02:04Z rbac: missing field principal_type -> defaulted to user
```
Priya Singh: looks like a policy merge bug in role-mapper; if principal_type is missing we fall back to a permissive merge result.
Maya Patel: Also observed audit.events[*].kms_key_id is missing in ~14 events. Makes tracing harder.
AuditBot: audit-alert: sampling rate for role_assign in staging increased from 100->1000 for triage.
Tom Reynolds: we flipped to role-matrix schema v2 in the backend last week — did the UI gating get the schema bump?
Jin Park: UI still reads `roleMatrix.flatmap` (legacy). Current code: ```js
const role = matrix[user.role] || 'viewer'
```
so if keys changed it can map wrong.
Maya Patel: quick repro script: `scripts/repro-kms-elev.sh` (runs on staging).
Priya Singh: Mitigation idea: server-side defensive check to reject UI-initiated role changes when payload contains `kms.rotate=true` or missing `principal_type`.
Tom Reynolds: I'll open a small PR to add a defensive check in role-mapper and a guard that rejects requests missing `principal_type`. We'll revert the UI shim until mapper fix lands. Assigning to @Tom Reynolds and @Jin Park for hotfix.
Jin Park: I'll revert the UI change in the feature branch and add a schema validation layer for roleMatrix responses.
Maya Patel: Action for audit: can we backfill kms_key_id for those 14 events from KMS audit logs? @audit-team
audit-team: got it — we'll try to correlate by timestamp and principal. Might take a day.
Priya Singh: Also recommend increasing retention for role_assign events to 90 days temporarily and raise alert if role_assign rate spikes > 2x baseline.
AuditBot: alert rule suggested: `rate(role_assign[5m]) > 2 * baseline_role_assign` — posting to infra-alerts.
Tom Reynolds: ETA for PR + staging deploy: ~2h for patch, validate, then canary to prod if green.
Jin Park: I'll run UI test matrix against v1 and v2 schemas before unblocking.
Maya Patel: Verified no evidence in prod yet — only staging repro. Still treat as P1 until audit backfill done.
oncall: acknowledged, will monitor anomalies and page if any prod blips.
Maya Patel: TL;DR: schema mismatch between UI and new role-matrix + role-mapper merge logic edge-case + KMS rotation interaction produced transient editor grants in staging. Hotfix PR + audit backfill in progress. :thumbsup:
Tom Reynolds: PR opened: #4321 — patch adds principal_type validation and refuses role changes when kms.rotate flag present, plus extra audit fields.
Maya Patel: thanks — will run repro after staging deploy and post result here.
Jin Park: after revert and validation I'll add a unit test to prevent regressions.
Maya Patel: moving to follow-up doc in the security runbook and will create a postmortem if backfill shows any similar events in prod.
